details.description: Sting energy drink is the perfect solution when you need a quick energy boost to charge up and keep you going throughout the day. Whether you're hitting the gym, studying for exams, or just need a pick-me-up, Sting has got you covered. This electrifying drink packs a powerful punch of caffeine, ginseng, and essential B vitamins to elevate your energy game and help you conquer your day. Sting also invigorates your taste buds with its refreshingly delicious flavour, making it the ultimate companion for boring moments, late-night gaming sessions, or any adventure needing an extra jolt. Not recommended for children, people sensitive to caffeine, or pregnant/breastfeeding women, but for everyone else, Sting is the Energy ka king that will keep you at your best.
details.ingredients: Carbonated Water, Sugar, Acidity Regulators (330, 331), Sequesterants (452(i), 385), Taurine, Caffeine (0.03%), Preservatives (211, 202), Sweeteners (955, 950), Inositol, Vitamin Premix. Contains Permitted Synthetic Food Colour (129) And Added Flavour (Natural And Nature Identical Flavouring Substances)
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight

details.description: Sting Energy Cans 180 ml deliver a bold and vibrant taste in a handy size, perfect for on-the-go moments. With its striking packaging and refreshing flavour, this drink adds a spark to your day. Conveniently sized, the 180 ml can is easy to carry and enjoy anytime, offering a quick burst of flavour.
details.ingredients: Carbonated Water, Sugar, Acidity Regulators(330,331), Flavour (Natural And Nature Identical Favouring Substances), Caffeine*(29 mg/100 ml), Preservatives (211, 202), Sweeteners (955, 950), Taurine, Colour (129), Sequestrant (385), Vitamins Premix.

Formulated with caffeine, taurine and B-vitamins, it delivers a distinctive taste experience in every sip. Its vibrant flavour and refreshing character make it a popular choice for those who enjoy a flavourful energy drink, whether at work, during travel or on the go.

details.description: Sting Gold Night Fuel delivers an electrifying jolt that energises you, helping you make the most of every moment with friends throughout the night. Its rich malt flavour enhances the experience. It also contains taurine and vitamins. This energy drink is not recommended for children, pregnant or breastfeeding women, or those sensitive to caffeine. For best results, consume no more than 500 ml per day.
